English: Warrior Patch
A rough patch of trampled earth where Magyar warriors gather for sparring and drills. The most basic of martial grounds.
Training Circle
A ring of wooden posts and marked ground, where warriors rotate through drills. Provides more organized and regular training.
Mounted Drill Yard
A broad field set aside for horsemen to practice mounted maneuvers and charges, vital for a nomadic warband.
Weapons Pavilion
A large, reinforced tent for storing and maintaining arms and armor, guarded and organized for rapid deployment.
Command Stand
A raised wooden platform for commanders to survey the field, issue orders, and coordinate the horde.
Battlefield Tent
A large, decorated tent that serves as the strategic heart of the encampment, with maps, messengers, and a guarded council.
Muster Hall
A sturdy timber structure for organizing mass gatherings, oath-swearings, and the mustering of the entire horde.
Elite Ground
A select training ground reserved for the hordes finest warriors and bodyguards, with advanced facilities and smiths.
Champions Pavilion
A lavish, fortified tent for the hordes greatest champions, with armorers, banners, and feasting tables to inspire all.
Magyar War Camp
The pinnacle of Magyar martial organization: a sprawling, fortified encampment with permanent structures for command, training, and celebration. The heart of a conquering horde.
